definitions.ask: Should a gate command that can never start (ENOEXEC) get its own failure code whose recovery offers only cancel?
definitions.why: resume/restart re-run the same hash-locked bytes, so they are certain to fail again

choices.label: New `command_not_executable` code; the recovery notification and TUI modal offer only cancel
Keep `command_start_failed` with resume/restart/cancel; only the error message gets clearer
